name: The Saints
description: The Saints were a street gang active near the Queens-Brooklyn border in the late 1950s and early 1960s, operating primarily in the Bushwick area of Brooklyn. The gang was organized into Senior and Junior divisions. Their rivals included the Halsey Bops, the Tots, the Jackson Gents, the Dukanes, the El Quintos, the Phantom Lords, and the Chaplains. They frequently clashed over territory with gangs originating from the Jackson Street Settlement House in Williamsburg.
